payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition of production versus depth curves in relation to carbonate producers and their growth rates at varying depths.

claims.text: The production versus depth curve represents the non-linear relationship between carbonate producer growth rate and water depth.
Dionisos classifies carbonate producers and adds a user-defined production-versus-depth value to each sediment class, indicating the growth rate's dependence on depth.
Growth curves for carbonate sediment classes are utilized to model production rates as either constant or linear over time intervals.
